# Salon.com
> Digital magazine covering news, politics, culture, food, science, health, money, essays, and video journalism.

Salon publishes reported news, opinion, criticism, personal essays, recipes, and feature writing across major current-affairs and lifestyle beats, with a strong emphasis on politics and culture.

## Core
- [Homepage](https://www.salon.com/): Main entry point for Salon’s latest news, commentary, culture, and feature stories.
- [Premium](https://www.salon.com/premium): Subscription offering for ad-light reading and member access information.
- [Newsletter](https://www.salon.com/newsletter): Signup page for Salon newsletters and recurring editorial updates.
- [TV](https://www.salon.com/tv): Video hub featuring interviews, segments, and Salon-produced visual journalism.

## News & Politics
- [News & Politics](https://www.salon.com/category/news-and-politics): Category hub for political news, analysis, opinion, and breaking current events.
- [Democrats must face reality on Israel](https://www.salon.com/2024/04/06/democrats-must-face-reality-on-israel/): Opinion piece on Democratic Party debate over support for Israel.
- [Trump’s Iran war has no clear endgame](https://www.salon.com/2025/06/21/trumps-iran-war-has-no-clear-endgame/): Reported analysis of Republican concerns over war aims and strategy.
- [Senate funds TSA, leaves out ICE](https://www.salon.com/2025/09/20/senate-funds-tsa-leaves-out-ice/): Coverage of DHS funding compromise and uncertainty in the House.
- [Kash Patel hacked by Iran-backed group](https://www.salon.com/2025/09/20/kash-patel-hacked-by-iran-backed-group/): News report on a hack exposing materials from Patel’s email.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.salon.com/category/culture): Hub for entertainment, books, style, criticism, and broader cultural commentary.
- [Smoking will never not look cool](https://www.salon.com/2025/09/20/smoking-will-never-not-look-cool/): Feature on smoking’s enduring screen image and young Hollywood’s fascination.
- [Sofia Coppola finds Marc Jacobs' whimsy](https://www.salon.com/2025/09/20/sofia-coppola-finds-marc-jacobs-whimsy/): Review of “Marc by Sofia” as a stylish documentary collaboration.
- [TV](https://www.salon.com/tv): Video interviews and cultural segments tied to Salon’s reporting and criticism.

## Food
- [Food](https://www.salon.com/category/food): Food reporting, recipes, cooking features, and essays on culinary culture.
- [Gen Z investing in Le Creuset](https://www.salon.com/2023/09/09/how-did-le-creuset-the-self-described-heirloom-quality-cookware-change-the-cooking-game/): Feature on cookware status, consumer trends, and cooking culture.
- [Food section archive](https://www.salon.com/category/food): Ongoing stream of recipes, ingredient explainers, and food-industry features.

## Science & Health
- [Science & Health](https://www.salon.com/category/science-and-health): Coverage of health, medicine, science news, and public-health commentary.
- [The New Sober Boom](https://www.salon.com/2023/12/16/navigating-the-new-sober-boom-where-a-persons-sobriety-is-as-unique-as-their-fingerprint/): Essay on sobriety trends, identity, and zero-proof social culture.
- [Getting Hooked on Quitting](https://www.salon.com/2023/12/30/secrets-of-a-serial-addict-how-i-got-hooked-on-quitting-over-and-over-again/): Personal essay about addiction, relapse, and repeated attempts at recovery.

## Money
- [Money](https://www.salon.com/category/money): Reporting and commentary on personal finance, work, markets, and economic life.
- [Dying Parents Costing Millennials Dear](https://www.salon.com/2023/08/26/my-parents-are-deadcan-i-afford-avocado-toast-now/): Personal finance essay on grief, inheritance, and millennial economic pressure.
- [SEC vs Celebrity Crypto Promoters](https://www.salon.com/2023/03/23/on-thursdays-we-wear-orange-sec-sues-lindsay-lohan-and-others-over-crypto-money-laundering-scam/): Report on SEC action involving celebrity crypto promotion allegations.

## Life Stories
- [Life Stories](https://www.salon.com/category/life-stories): Personal essays and first-person narratives about family, identity, work, and change.
- [The New Sober Boom](https://www.salon.com/2023/12/16/navigating-the-new-sober-boom-where-a-persons-sobriety-is-as-unique-as-their-fingerprint/): First-person feature on individualized sobriety and social expectations.
- [Getting Hooked on Quitting](https://www.salon.com/2023/12/30/secrets-of-a-serial-addict-how-i-got-hooked-on-quitting-over-and-over-again/): Memoir-style essay about addiction and the cycle of quitting.

## Education & Ideas
- [Liberal Arts Cuts Are Dangerous](https://www.salon.com/2024/03/16/ignorance-and-democracy-capitalisms-long-against-higher-education/): Commentary on higher education, democracy, and the erosion of liberal arts.
- [Is College Necessary?](https://www.salon.com/2022/09/16/college-was-necessary-for-me-will-my-own-child-need-it-like-i-did/): Essay weighing the value of college across generations and changing economics.
- [News & Politics](https://www.salon.com/category/news-and-politics): Broader political and social commentary often intersecting with education policy.

## Video
- [Salon TV](https://www.salon.com/tv): Central video destination for interviews, explainers, and cultural programming.
- [Homepage](https://www.salon.com/): Front page regularly features embedded video alongside top stories.
- [Culture](https://www.salon.com/category/culture): Many entertainment and criticism pieces connect to Salon’s video coverage.
